reason: ₹499 is nothing for me, but I'd take the free first collab because the café asked and stop there. My content is what brands pay me for, so I'm not paying for a pass that also has me making promo videos for businesses for free, and Influish already gets me enough campaigns.
objection: The pass makes me shoot promotional videos for 'participating businesses' with no fee mentioned. At my size that's unpaid work, and it cheapens my rate card. On top of that it's a tiny beta, Bengaluru only, up against an app that has lakhs of creators and brands already.
would_change_my_mind: Drop the free promo-video requirement, or pay me my rate for those videos, and show me that the businesses on Mitra pay real fees at my follower range, not just barter.
